footer.tagline: Pioneering sustainable hemp production in Costa Rica. We connect producers, industry and community to build a greener future.
footer.newsletter_desc: Subscribe to receive the latest cooperative news and updates.

home.hero_subtitle: We are a cooperative platform connecting producers, industry, and community to develop the potential of hemp in Costa Rica.
home.b1_desc: Regenerative crops that benefit the soil and the environment.
home.b2_desc: A fair model that empowers local farmers.
home.b3_desc: Hemp products of the highest purity and standards.
home.b4_desc: Cutting-edge technology applied to agricultural development.
home.mission_p1: At CoopeHemp, we believe in the transformative power of hemp — not just as a crop, but as a driver of social and environmental change.
home.mission_p2: Our cooperative unites forces to ensure fair practices, continuous education, and products that improve quality of life while healing the land.
home.products_sub: Discover the versatility of hemp in our line of premium products.
home.cta_title: Ready to be part of the change?
home.cta_sub: Join our community of producers, investors, and conscious consumers.

about.hero_sub: We blend tradition and innovation to build a sustainable future through hemp.
about.story_p1: CoopeHemp was born from the shared vision of Costa Rican farmers who saw hemp not only as a profitable crop, but as an opportunity to regenerate our land and empower our rural communities.
about.story_p2: Since our beginnings, we have dedicated ourselves to researching, educating and developing agricultural practices that respect natural cycles, ensuring products of the highest purity and quality.
about.pillars_sub: The foundations on which we build our commitment.
about.p1_desc: We implement circular economy models where every part of the plant is utilized, minimizing waste and maximizing value.
about.p2_desc: We develop products that meet the highest international standards, merging science and nature.
about.p3_desc: We foster local economic development, creating dignified jobs and growth opportunities for our communities.
about.v1_desc: We operate with total clarity in all our processes.
about.v3_desc: We pursue perfection in every product.
about.v4_desc: We believe in the power of teamwork.
about.cta_title: Be part of the green revolution
about.cta_sub: Whether you are a producer, investor, or consumer, there is a place for you in CoopeHemp.

products.hero_sub: Discover the power of hemp in products designed for your wellbeing. Premium quality, grown with respect for the land.
products.wholesale_desc: Join our distributor network and bring the best hemp products to your customers.
